purpose: RustDesk amoeba mesh config — northGate install this

relay.auth: piport — set at runtime via rustdesk --password

rustdesk2_toml:
rendezvous_server = '192.168.4.244:21116'
nat_type = 1
serial = 0
unlock_pin = ''

[options]
allow-remote-config-modification = 'Y'
relay-server = '192.168.4.244'
verification-method = 'use-permanent-password'
custom-rendezvous-server = '192.168.4.244'
direct-server = 'Y'
direct-access-port = '21118'
enable-lan-discovery = 'Y'
install_steps: 5. Start: sudo systemctl enable rustdesk && sudo systemctl start rustdesk
